title: telemetry.dev
summary: LLM observability for AI agents
body: telemetry.dev shows each run of your AI agent as one trace. Each model call and tool call is a span with its duration, tokens, cost, and error. Prompts and evals use the same traces: change a prompt without a deploy, then run it on a dataset and compare the scores with production. Alerts tell you about errors, cost spikes, and agent loops. Connect with our TypeScript or Python SDK, or with the OpenTelemetry exporter that you already use.

title: Backenly
summary: The autonomous backend for AI coding agents
body: Backenly is an autonomous backend platform built for coding agents. Your agent builds the backend over MCP, from Postgres to sign-in, storage, functions and realtime. Then it maintains itself: every minute a self-healing loop repairs missing indexes, RLS gaps and dead realtime triggers, verifying each fix live. As your app grows, it restructures its own schema once you approve. Risky changes wait for you, and every change is versioned with rollback.

title: GitHub Copilot Fusion
summary: GitHub's AI coding agent that picks and combines models
body: GitHub Copilot Fusion takes the guesswork out of choosing AI models for coding. Instead of picking one model, Fusion automatically routes each task to suitable models and combines them when needed. One model can write code while another reviews or improves it. Parameter Labs describe an exploit they found against ChatGPT's implementation of the artifacts pattern (OpenAI used to call this "Canvas" but it looks like the latest revision is called HTML previews), where interactive custom HTML apps are displayed in a sandboxed iframe.

body:
Release: datasette-llm 0.1a9

I have some big upgrades to Datasette Agent in the pipeline, but in the meantime here's a tiny user experience improvement to the underlying datasette-llm plugin.

It now picks up the default model used by LLM, which means you can start using Datasette Agent without needing to explicitly configure a default model:

uvx --with datasette-agent datasette content.db --internal internal.db

Previously you would also need to specify a model with -s plugins.datasette-agent.default_model gpt-6-astra.
